edges.reason: Player must locate the beehive area first; melon planting follows discovery of the garden ecosystem area
The mined dark oak sign is repurposed as a garden label/marker placed in the garden
Red mushroom is a decorative plant element incorporated into the garden build
Planted melon crop must exist as part of the garden's cultivated area
Filled cauldron serves as visible water feature/irrigation within the garden
Polished blackstone slabs are placed as flooring material inside the cave structure
Warped trapdoor is installed as the cave entrance door
Oak button is mounted on cave wall as a redstone mechanism to control the trapdoor

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' is an observation/locate task requiring the player to navigate to and visually confirm the bee_nest. The bee_nest is at spawn-relative (-5, 4, -5) on the oak tree. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk to the tree since spawn is ~8.1 blocks away (exceeds threshold). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking up toward the beehive.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_wall_sign drops a dark_oak_sign item which ends up in the player's inventory. The sign is at spawn-relative (-4, 1, 3) mounted on an oak_fence post. Player uses the provided wooden_axe to break it efficiently.

Uses inventory_has because mining a red_mushroom block drops the red_mushroom item into inventory. The mushroom is at spawn-relative (5, 0, -2) placed on podzol at (5, -1, -2) which prevents light-level pop-off regardless of ambient light conditions.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_button places it in the player's inventory. The valid crafting chain is: mine oak_log at (2,0,1) → craft into 4 oak_planks → craft 1 oak_plank into 1 oak_button using the provided crafting_table. Player must place the crafting table first.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='water_cauldron' because in Java 1.17+ using a water_bucket on an empty cauldron converts the block to 'water_cauldron'. The cauldron is at spawn-relative (3, 0, 5). Box is ±2 around the cauldron for tolerance.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='melon_stem' because planting melon_seeds on farmland creates a melon_stem block at the surface level. Farmland is at spawn-relative (-2 to 0, -1, 6 to 8) with water source at (-1,-1,7) for hydration. Stems appear at y=0 (one above farmland). Box generously covers the farmland area.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_blackstone_slab with the provided wooden_pickaxe drops the slab item into inventory. The slabs are in a 3x3 area at spawn-relative (8-10, 0, 5-7). A pickaxe is required — the scene provides a wooden_pickaxe which is sufficient (no minimum tier for polished blackstone).

Uses inventory_has because mining a warped_trapdoor drops the warped_trapdoor item into inventory. Located at spawn-relative (8, 0, 4). The provided wooden_axe speeds up mining but any tool or bare hand works — warped trapdoor always drops itself.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' and object='oak_fence' because a garden requires structural borders/fencing. Player is given 6 oak_fence blocks. One pre-existing fence post at (-4,0,3) is within the check region, so min_count=4 requires the player to place at least 3 NEW fences — ensuring meaningful construction beyond the single pre-existing post.

Uses three count_in_box_at_least rules to verify ALL dependency-chain materials were placed in the cave structure near the stone hillside at spawn-relative (7-14, -2 to 5, -10 to -3). Requires: (1) polished_blackstone_slab as flooring, (2) warped_trapdoor as entrance door, (3) oak_button as redstone mechanism. All three must be present to confirm the cave incorporates materials from all prerequisite tasks.

scene_description: A compact outdoor area supporting all 10 tasks with fully validated Minecraft mechanics. The scene features two main build zones (garden in the south, cave in the northeast) connected by gathering tasks spread across the area. Key elements: dark oak wall sign on fence post (SW), oak log near spawn (center), red mushroom on podzol under dark oak tree (E), beehive on oak tree (NW), empty cauldron (SE), hydrated farmland (S), polished blackstone slabs and warped trapdoor (E), and stone hillside proto-cave (NE). Player is given all necessary tools and building materials.
task_text: Complete a series of building and gathering tasks: Find the beehive in the oak tree to the northwest. Mine the dark oak wall sign from the fence post. Mine the red mushroom under the dark oak tree. Mine the oak log and craft an oak button from the planks using your crafting table. Fill the empty cauldron with water using your water bucket. Plant melon seeds on the farmland to the south. Build a garden in the southern area using fences, flowers, and the gathered elements. Mine the polished blackstone slabs and warped trapdoor to the east, then build a cave in the stone hillside to the northeast, incorporating the slabs as flooring, the trapdoor as an entrance, and the oak button as a mechanism.
design_notes: SPATIAL LAYOUT (all spawn-relative coordinates): Ground level is y=-1 (grass_block), player walks at y=0 level. SOUTHWEST: Dark oak wall sign on oak_fence post at (-4, 0-1, 3). CENTER: Oak log at (2, 0, 1) for crafting chain. EAST: Dark oak tree trunk at (5, 0-4, -3) with dense canopy at y=4-5. Red mushroom at (5, 0, -2) sitting on podzol at (5, -1, -2) — podzol ensures light-independent stability. NORTHWEST: Oak tree trunk at (-6, 0-5, -5) with canopy at y=4-6. Bee_nest at (-5, 4, -5) facing east — visible from ground. Empty chest at (-5, 0, -4) near beehive tree. SOUTHEAST: Empty cauldron at (3, 0, 5). SOUTH: Farmland 3x3 at (-2 to 0, -1, 6 to 8) at ground level. Water source at (-1, -1, 7) — same y-level as farmland, within 4 blocks of all farmland blocks, ensures hydration. EAST: Polished blackstone slabs 3x3 at (8-10, 0, 5-7). Warped trapdoor at (8, 0, 4). NORTHEAST: Stone hillside at (10-12, -1 to 4, -8 to -5) with hollow interior (air at 10-12, 0-3, -7 to -6) and entrance at (10, 0, -5). PLAYER INVENTORY: wooden_axe (for signs/wood/trapdoor), wooden_pickaxe (for blackstone slabs), crafting_table (for oak_button recipe), water_bucket (for cauldron), melon_seeds x4 (for planting), oak_fence x6 (for garden borders), poppy x3 (for garden decoration), bone_meal x4 (for growing plants). KEY MECHANICS VERIFIED: (1) oak_log → 4 oak_planks → 1 oak_button is valid crafting chain. (2) wooden_pickaxe mines polished_blackstone_slab (no minimum tier required). (3) podzol allows red_mushroom regardless of light level. (4) water at same y as farmland hydrates within 4 blocks. (5) dark_oak_wall_sign drops dark_oak_sign item. (6) melon_seeds on farmland creates melon_stem block.
